name: Ancient Shrine Beacon
description: A stone shrine built around a beacon, with weathered pillars circling a raised platform. The beam rises from the center, and the platform keeps the buff zone easy to reach. Plain stone blocks, quick to put up. Works as a temple piece or a base landmark.

name: Arcane Crystal Beacon
description: A crystal beacon base in end stone and purpur, with a purple beam rising from the center. Curved pillars with flower ends stand around a sand platform dotted with amethyst. Fits an End theme base or a magic build area.

name: Astral Beacon
description: A beacon tower in blackstone with two curved arms holding a purple beam. Tinted glass floats at the top and lines the column so the beam glows through. Takes a fair stack of blackstone. Works as a landmark or spawn marker.

name: Beacon Fountain
description: A fountain that wraps a beacon in quartz arches, with water falling around the beam. The beacon buff still works, so it earns its spot at spawn. Quartz, lanterns and leaves do most of the look. Sits well in a town square or outside your base.

name: Beacon Tree
description: A beacon hidden inside a large oak tree, with the beam rising through the canopy. Lanterns hang from the branches and a terraced trunk base with steps and flowers leads up to it. Logs, leaves and lanterns cover most of the cost. A centerpiece for a garden or base courtyard.

name: Color Changing Beacon
description: A beacon setup that changes its beam color, with the beacon boxed in glass on a small base. Swap the stained glass above it to shift the beam to any color you want. Cheap once you have the beacon itself. Use it as a base marker you can recolor anytime.

name: Crimson Beacon
description: A nether-themed beacon tower in blackstone and nether bricks, with a red beam and crimson arms near the top. The base spreads into netherrack for a corrupted look. Needs a full beacon underneath, so save it for mid game. Marks your base from far away.

name: Magical Beacon
description: A beacon shrine with a purple amethyst roof on bone-white pillars, lanterns hanging from chains. The beam runs straight through the open canopy. Amethyst is the main cost, the rest is common. Marks a base or a mystical spot on the map from far away.

name: Magical Dragon Beacon
description: A beacon shrine under a cherry blossom canopy, raised on a deepslate platform with lanterns and candles. Stone steps lead up to the beam, which rises through the blossoms. Cherry leaves, logs and deepslate cover most of it. Suits a cherry grove or a japanese base.

name: Medieval Beacon
description: A minecraft tower for your beacon, medieval style, in dark wood with cobblestone trim and a spire roof. The beam fires straight out the top so the buff range stays. Wood and stone all the way, cheap to build. Fits any medieval base or village edge.

name: Medieval Beacon Tower
description: A medieval minecraft tower built to house a beacon, with wood columns below and dark stone spires above. The beam fires up through the roof, and the open base lets you walk in for the buffs. Uses logs and stone bricks. Fits castle grounds or a village square.

name: Mushroom Beacon
description: A beacon base shaped like a giant mushroom, with a red cap, white spots and a pale stem. The beam shoots straight up through the cap. Built from bricks and quartz over your pyramid, so it stays cheap on top. Works as a landmark you can spot from far off.

name: Rainbow Beacon
description: A beacon tower with a rainbow beam rising from an iron block base. The beacon sits under glass on a small platform, with stained glass coloring the beam every few blocks. Marks your base from far away once you have a beacon to power it.

name: Aesthetic Bakery
description: A bakery with a flower-covered roof, an open counter and a brick chimney with smoke. Cake and treats sit out on the front bar under lanterns. Uses dark logs, planks and leaf blocks. Works as a villager shop on any town street.

name: Aesthetic Cottage
description: A minecraft cottage with a slate-look stone roof, leaf overgrowth and an A-frame tower with a balcony. Open porch rooms hold beds and seating, with garden beds along the fenced deck. A wide footprint that takes plenty of wood and stone. Fits a forest clearing or the center of a farm base.

name: Akari Sanctuary
description: A small japanese house with a flared pagoda roof, stone walls and dark wood trim. One room inside, enough for a bed, chest and crafting table. Uses common survival blocks, so you can build it early. Works on its own or as part of a Japanese village.

name: Apple Starter House
description: A minecraft house shaped like a red apple, with a wood stem and leaf on top and a small porch at the door. Tall windows let light into the single room. Mostly red concrete and wool, nothing rare. A fun landmark for a plains base or themed village.

name: Aqua Modern Base
description: A modern house in white concrete with glass railings, tiered balconies and a small pool out front. Three levels of open rooms, with outdoor stairs linking the terraces. Concrete takes some smelting, so plan a stack of it. Fits a plains base or a modern city plot.

name: Bakery Baker's House
description: A medieval bakery house with a steep wood roof, a smoking stone chimney and a cake stall out front. A villager-style shop with a counter, barrels and a lantern-lit oven corner. Built from logs, planks and cobblestone. Slots straight into a village market street.

name: Blimp Survival Base
description: A flying survival base built as a wood airship hanging under a white balloon with strap detailing. The hull deck has lanterns, a propeller at the stern and room to live on board. Takes a lot of wood and wool up in the sky. A base nobody reaches without wings or blocks.

name: Blue Dragon House
description: A minecraft house shaped like a blue monster head, with stone horns and an open mouth for the entrance. The glass-walled jaw holds the living space, with white teeth framing it. Blue concrete and glass do most of the work. Drop it anywhere you want a build people will walk over to.

name: Brick Cottage
description: A small minecraft cottage with brick upper walls, a tuff base and a steep deepslate tile roof. Window boxes, hanging vines and a furnace set into the wall beside the door. Bricks, tuff and spruce, nothing rare, and a narrow footprint. Fits a village edge or a forest clearing.

name: Bridge House
description: A medieval house built on a stone bridge, so the river runs right under it. Two timber-framed floors above the arch, plus a bell tower with a spire. Takes a good amount of stone and dark wood. Drop it over any river to cross it and live on it at the same time.

name: Cabin Starter House
description: A small cabin starter house with dark log walls, a stepped roof and stone accents at the door. One room inside, room for a bed, chest and crafting table. Built from spruce wood and cobblestone, so it works from day one. Fits any forest or plains spawn.

name: Candy Cane Cabin
description: A small minecraft house with a snow-covered roof and a candy-stripe doorway in red and white. One-room cabin with wool trim in blue, yellow and green on brown walls. Uses cheap blocks, mostly wool and snow. Fits a winter village or a Christmas world.

name: Cherry Blossom House
description: A two-story survival house in pink bricks with a dark wood roof, a balcony and flowering vines up the walls. Two doors, big windows and planter boxes out front. The cherry blossom palette takes some gathering, but the shape is simple. Fits a cherry grove or any spring-themed base.

name: Cherry Blossom House (Japanese House)
description: A japanese house with a pink tiled roof, a full-width balcony and two covered wings at ground level. The upper floor sits open behind the balcony rail, with blossom bushes framing each wing. Mostly wood and pink slabs. A centerpiece for a cherry grove base.

name: Cherry Blossom Starter House
description: A starter house in pink planks and dark trim with a red brick roof and a front balcony. Two joined sections give you a main room plus an upper floor. Simple blocks, simple shape, quick to copy. A solid first base for a new survival world.

name: Cherry Blossom Survival House
description: A small survival house in pink cherry planks with a stone slab roof and a blossom tree growing over the top. Grass stairs lead up to the door, with a covered work porch on stilts at the side. Cherry wood and stone keep it cheap. Drop it anywhere in a cherry grove.

name: Cherry Blossom Survival Starter House
description: A starter house in plain wood with a pink roof and two raised farm plots attached at the side. You get a living space, a covered porch and crop beds with stairs between them. Common wood blocks throughout, so it works from day one. House and food supply in one build.

name: Cherry Japanese House
description: A large japanese house with stacked pink roofs, dark wood framing and a stone stair entrance. Two floors of interior space behind tall windows, with lanterns hung from the eaves. It takes plenty of wood and pink blocks. Suits a temple district or a big cherry build.

name: Christmas Tree House
description: A giant Christmas tree with layered green tiers, wool ornaments and a gold star, standing on a wood trunk. The trunk holds the entrance, with lit windows at the base. Mostly green wool and logs, cheap to gather. Drop it in a winter village or spawn plaza.

name: Cottage Floating Island
description: A minecraft cottage on a floating island, with a leafy arch of hanging lanterns and waterfalls pouring off the edges. Wood cabin, small pond, crop patch and a seating spot with a campfire. A sky base you can park above your world or a skyblock map.

name: Cottagecore House
description: A minecraft cottage in wood and stone with an attached greenhouse wing under glass. Two floors, a balcony with flowers, lanterns and vines on the walls. Takes a fair stack of logs, stone bricks and glass. Suits a forest clearing or a village edge.

name: Cube Survival Base
description: A big minecraft base built from stacked wood-frame cubes with glass walls and trees on the roof. Each cube is its own room, linked by ladders and a small bridge, with waterfalls running between floors. Mostly wood and glass, but the size means plenty of blocks. Works as a survival base for a group.

name: Cubic House
description: A small minecraft house shaped like a cube and covered in vines, with a wood doorway and glass peeking through the leaves. From outside it reads as a hedge with a door. Wood, glass and plenty of leaf blocks. Hides well in forests and survival worlds.

name: Cute Cherry Blossom House
description: A pink minecraft house with a stone slab roof, blossom leaves on top and an open front wall. Inside there is one wide room with space for storage and crafting, plus a small pond by the entrance. Built from cherry planks and stone. Fits any grassy spot near a cherry grove.

name: Dark Oak Starter House
description: A starter house with a steep dark oak roof, cobblestone walls and a leaf-covered chimney. One room inside for a bed, chest and crafting table, plus a covered side stall for storage. Wood and cobblestone only, so it works on day one. A solid first survival house.

name: Desert House
description: A desert house in sandstone with a wooden roof, a pergola and a rooftop garden. Two floors, an open porch below and outside stairs up to the terrace. Sandstone and wood, all easy to get in a desert. Fits right into a desert village or an oasis base.

name: Desert Starter House
description: A desert starter house in sandstone with a terracotta base and a flat walled roof. Two floors, outside stairs and a shaded ground-level porch. Built from blocks you dig up around any desert village, so it goes up fast. Fits right into a sand biome.

name: Dirt House
description: A starter house shaped like a grass mound, with dirt walls, lanterns and a wooden door under a terraced green roof. One hidden room inside the hill. Dirt, grass and a bit of wood, so you can build it on day one. Blends into any plains or forest spawn.

name: Farmhouse With Garden
description: A wooden survival house with a fenced wraparound deck, garden plots underneath and lanterns along the rails. Two floors inside plus deck space and crop rows below. Mostly logs, planks and fences, so it suits an early world. A full farmstead in one build.

name: First Night House
description: A small starter house with a stone roof, wood walls and a covered porch with a chimney. One room inside, enough for a bed, chest and crafting table, with crates and plants dressing the outside. Common survival blocks, so you can build it on day one. Made to get you through the first night.

name: Fishing Hut
description: A fishing hut built over the water with a stone-capped roof and a lantern-lit dock. Barrels, a boat and an open pier below for casting lines. Spruce, oak and stone, nothing hard to gather. Put it on a lake or river edge near your base.

name: Giant Oak Treehouse
description: A giant minecraft treehouse with two small huts perched on the branches of a tall custom tree. Steps spiral up the trunk to reach each platform. The tree itself takes plenty of logs and leaves. Works as a lookout home or a jungle-style base.

name: Giant Wither Statue House
description: A minecraft statue of the Wither, built big in blackstone with three white-eyed heads and a ribbed spine you can enter. A ladder runs up inside the body. Dark blocks make up most of the cost. A landmark piece for a base entrance or boss-themed area.

name: Glass House with Huge Tree
description: A modern house wrapped in a glass cylinder around a huge tree, three floors up the trunk. White spiral stairs, planters and seating on every level. Takes plenty of glass plus wood and quartz. Works as a tower base or a garden showpiece.

name: Hills House
description: Credit: Gorillo

name: Japanese House
description: A two-story japanese house in dark wood with a layered roof, a balcony and lantern lighting. Two floors of living space with an outside staircase and a covered porch. Built from spruce, deepslate and stone, all survival-friendly blocks. Works as a main base or the centerpiece of a village.

name: Lake House
description: A small lake house with wood walls, a cobblestone roof and a covered front porch. A plank dock with a boat and lanterns runs out over the water. Cheap wood and cobble all the way through. Drop it on any shoreline as a starter house.

name: Large Cherry Blossom Survival House
description: A large cherry blossom survival house in pink blocks with a steep gray roof, a tall tower and a covered porch. Two floors, a balcony and flower beds along the walls. Cherry wood and bricks do most of the work. Suits a cherry grove or a pink-themed base.

name: Large Duo Survival House
description: A large survival house in dark wood on cobblestone stilts, built as two matching wings with a shared front staircase. Balconies with flower boxes wrap the raised floor, with lanterns all around. Logs, planks and cobble, all cheap to farm. Room enough for two players to live in.

name: Large Medieval House
description: A large medieval house with a tall clock tower, timber-framed walls and steep spired roofs. Two floors plus the tower, with arched windows and flower boxes all around. A big build that takes plenty of wood, stone bricks and deepslate. Fits as the centerpiece of a medieval town.

name: Medieval Blacksmith
description: A medieval blacksmith house with stone brick walls, a wooden roof and a chimney. An open forge sits under the awning with a smithing table, an armor stand and a stone path to the door. Takes plenty of stone bricks and wood. Fits any medieval village.

name: Medieval Copper House
description: A medieval house in two joined parts, one tall with a copper roof, one low with a wood gable and chimney. A round window on the front and side stairs up to the tall half. Copper, wood and stone cover the whole build. Works as a survival home or a village shop.

name: Medieval Forge
description: A medieval house with a steep dark roof, a brick chimney and an open forge on the ground floor. The smithy sits under the overhang, with a stone patio out front. Common wood, brick and stone throughout. Works as the blacksmith stop in a medieval village.

name: Medieval House
description: A two-story medieval house with twin gabled roofs, dark wood framing and a balcony on stone pillars. Two floors of rooms plus a covered side porch and open space under the deck. Takes plenty of spruce, dark oak and stone, so plan a few gathering trips. A solid main base for a survival world.

name: Medieval Hut
description: A small medieval house in cobblestone and wood with a brick chimney and a stone path to the door. Room inside for a bed, chest and crafting table. Common early blocks, so it works as a starter house. Stands alone or starts off a medieval village.

name: Medieval Starter House
description: A medieval starter house with a steep cobbled roof, dark wood frame and a stone stairway up the side. A covered work corner outside holds your furnace and crafting spot. Wood and stone all the way, cheap to gather early. A solid first base for a survival world.

name: Medieval Survival House
description: A medieval house with a steep copper roof, stone base and dark wood framing. Two floors, an open porch at the door and lanterns on the walls. The weathered copper takes time to oxidise, the rest is common blocks. Fits a medieval village or a hillside plot.

name: Medieval Tavern
description: A medieval house sized as a tavern, with two timber-framed wings around a central stone tower. Two floors of windows, a side pergola and lantern-lit walls. A big build in wood, stone and deep slate. Works as the centerpiece of a medieval village.

name: Mediterranean Survival House
description: A big Mediterranean minecraft mansion with a terracotta roof, cream walls and wood balconies. Two floors, plenty of window space and a landscaped front yard with paths and hedges. A large build that takes plenty of blocks. Fits as the main house on an established survival world.

name: Mega Medieval House
description: A big medieval house with swept rooftops, a central spire, a stone chimney and a porch out front. Two floors, a balcony, window boxes and a small crop garden along the side wall. A large build that takes plenty of dark wood, stone and time. Works as the main hall of a medieval village.

name: Mini Starter House
description: A tiny starter house built as one wooden column, with trapdoor walls and a lantern hanging over the door. Just enough space inside for your first night. Costs a handful of wood, so you can build it in the first ten minutes. Use it as a night-one shelter, then upgrade later.

name: Modern Black House
description: A two-story modern house in black concrete and white quartz with tinted glass across the front. Recessed entrance below, a glass-walled room above, all on a stone slab platform. Concrete and glass take some smelting, so it suits mid game. Fits a modern city plot or a plains base.

name: Modern Glass House
description: A three-story modern house in dark concrete with glass walls, a wooden interior and an indoor pool on the ground floor. Open living space above, outside stairs running up the side. Concrete and lots of glass, so gather sand first. Suits a modern neighborhood or a cliffside plot.

name: Modern House
description: A small modern house in white concrete and wood, with a flat overhang and a pool at the side. Two floors, a wide window strip upstairs and a hedge-lined patio outside. Concrete and planks keep the material list short. An easy first modern base for survival.

name: Modern Starter House
description: A modern house for starters with a flat roof, a glass front and a side staircase wrapped in vines. Two levels: a stone base below and a wooden room above, lit with lanterns. Uses common wood and stone bricks, fine for early game. A clean first base for a fresh survival world.

name: Modern Underground House
description: A modern house built fully underground, with white-framed rooms sunk into the grass under open skylights. A kitchen, a living area with a long counter, a wide staircase and a small courtyard. Quartz, wood and glass on top of a lot of digging. A clean hidden base that leaves the surface untouched.

name: Mountain Cliff House
description: A starter house set into the side of a cliff, with a wood roof, a balcony over the drop and floating steps leading up. One room carved into the rock, lit by lanterns, with a view off the edge. Mostly wood against stone. For mountain worlds where flat ground is scarce.

name: Mountain Hanging House
description: A minecraft house hanging off a cliff, held by a stone arm anchored into the mountain. A round pod with glass walls, a ladder inside and a grass roof on top. Takes plenty of stone and glass, and building over the drop is the hard part. A base for mountain worlds.

name: Mushroom Tree Stump House
description: A house built inside a giant tree stump, covered in leaves with red mushrooms growing on top. A wooden door, lanterns and a dirt path lead in. Mostly logs, leaves and mushroom blocks. Fits a forest or a fairy-tale corner of your world.

name: Nintendo Switch House
description: A minecraft house shaped like a Nintendo Switch, laid flat with a blue and a red controller on each side. The screen opens into one furnished room with a bed, chests and a furnace. Mostly concrete and wool. Fun centerpiece for a themed world.

name: Oak Cottage Treehouse
description: A minecraft treehouse with a cottage room set on a thick trunk, a railed deck all around and a leaf canopy overhead. One room up top, a ladder to climb, lanterns and a tire swing below. Built from oak logs, planks and leaves. Works as a starter home in any forest.

name: Overgrown Pyramid House
description: A pyramid house in stone brick and wood with glass tiers wrapping each step and leaf patches on the slopes. Lanterns and a small crown structure sit at the peak. Stone, wood and glass, nothing rare. A different shape for a survival base on open ground.

name: Plains Starter House
description: A small starter house with a brick chimney, a granite roof and a covered side pergola. One room inside, enough for a bed, chest and crafting table, with front steps up to the door. Wood, cobblestone and bricks, so it suits an early survival world.

name: Pumpkin House
description: A pumpkin-shaped minecraft house with orange walls, a dark wood entrance, a brick chimney and leaves growing over the top. A small pumpkin shed and fenced patch sit beside it. Built from pumpkins, wood and bricks. Fits a Halloween world or a fall-themed village.

name: Pyramid House
description: A big pyramid-shaped minecraft house for the desert, built from sandstone and stone with orange trim. Twin staircases lead up past cactus planters to a lit entrance and terraces. Takes plenty of sandstone, so plan a mining trip. Fits any desert biome.

name: Raft Base
description: A floating raft starter house built from wood, with a sail, a trellis roof and lantern-lit walls. Bed, furnace, chests and crafting space packed on one open deck. Common wood blocks, quick to build. A first base for ocean or island survival.

name: Regular Medieval House
description: A medieval house with a steep slate roof, a stone base, timber-framed walls and a smoking brick chimney. Two floors, an open balcony and a covered side porch with a small fenced crop garden. Uses stone, dark wood and deepslate. Fits a medieval village or works as a survival home.

name: Riverside Fishing Hut
description: A fishing hut on a river dock, with red-stained walls, a stone chimney and a fish sign hanging above the roof. Fenced pier with barrels and space to moor a boat. Wood, terracotta and fences, nothing rare. Sits on any river or lake edge.

name: Riverside House
description: Credit: Gorillo

name: Riverside Mountain Base
description:
A cozy rustic mountain base built into the hillside with stunning riverside views. Features a multi-level stone structure with spruce wood accents, a functional workshop area, enchanting room, storage space, and beautiful landscaping with flowering plants.

Credit: Gorillo

name: Riverside Starter House
description: Credit: Gorillo

name: Safe House
description: A small minecraft house inside a walled compound with a watchtower at each corner. One stone cottage in the middle, hedge rows and two wheat fields inside the walls. Stone bricks and common crops, nothing rare. Works as a survival base that keeps mobs on the other side of the wall.

name: Savannah Starter House
description: Credit: Gorillo

name: Sewer Base
description: An underground base built as a sewer outlet, hidden behind iron bars in a stone arch at the waterline of a cliff. The barred gate opens into a lit tunnel that leads to your rooms inside. Stone bricks and iron bars cover the entrance. Good as a secret survival hideout.

name: Shrek Swamp
description: A swamp hut styled after Shrek's home, a wood shack under a grass-topped mound with a tall stump rising behind it. Log steps and an outhouse sit out front. Takes plenty of logs, grass and vines. A survival house for swamps or a movie-themed world.

name: Simple Mini House
description: A tiny starter house with barrel walls, one window and a grass roof. One room inside, enough for a bed, chest and crafting table. Barrels and wood only, so you can build it on day one. Good as a first shelter or a spare hut on the edge of your base.

name: Simple Oak Starter House
description: A starter house built from stacked oak logs, like a woodpile with a door and a glass skylight strip. One room inside for a bed, chest and crafting table. Just logs, torches and a bit of glass, buildable on day one. Blends into any forest spawn.

name: Simple Underwater House
description: A simple underwater house with a glass dome over a wooden platform on the sea floor. Open living space inside with sea lanterns lighting the sand around it. Mostly glass and planks, but expect plenty of draining. Works as a survival base in any ocean.

name: Small Dark Oak House
description: A small minecraft cottage in dark oak with a deepslate roof and a calcite chimney. One room inside for a bed, chest and crafting table, plus a covered porch by the door. Cheap to build from dark oak and stone. Works as a starter home or a side house in a village.

name: Small Fisherman House
description: A small minecraft house on a beach dock, with a wood pier, fence posts and lanterns over the water. One hut on the sand, boats moored at the jetty. Mostly logs, planks and fences. Fits any shoreline where you fish or park your boat.

name: Small Medieval House
description: A small medieval house in minecraft with stone brick walls, dark wood beams and a two-level wooden roof. Two floors inside with room for the basics. Uses stone bricks and common wood, fine for early survival. Fits a medieval village or as a lone survival house.

name: Small Modern Building
description: A small minecraft house on two floors in polished tuff and mud brick, with a pink striped awning over the ground floor. Glass walls upstairs hold potted plants and hanging lanterns, with a bed, shelves and storage inside. Tuff, sandstone and mixed planks throughout. Fits a village street or a town plot.

name: Small Modern House
description: A small modern house shaped as a black concrete cube with a glass front wall. Two floors inside: furnaces and storage below, a bed and seating above. Concrete and glass are the whole cost. Works as a compact survival base by the water or in a city plot.

name: Small Mountain Houses
description: A small starter house set into a sheer mountain wall, with a wood platform, door and window reached by a long ladder. One room carved into the stone, enough for basic storage. A few logs, planks and ladders on top of some digging. A quick cliffside shelter that keeps mobs below you.

name: Small Observatory House
description: A small minecraft house with white walls, wood balconies and a leafy dome roof, topped with a lantern spire. Two floors inside, with flowers and grass around the base. Uses common blocks in modest amounts. Works as a garden home or a wizard-style cottage.

name: Small Riverside House
description: Credit: Gorillo

name: Small Survival House
description: A small survival house in dark wood with a cobblestone roof and a covered porch. One room inside plus a fenced wheat plot by the door. Cheap logs and cobble, so you can build it on day one. Sits well in a plains or forest spawn.

name: Small Underground House
description: A hidden underground base under a lid of wooden trapdoors flush with the grass. Below sits a compact room with a bed, storage and a crafting spot. Costs almost nothing, mostly digging. A safe first shelter that mobs and other players walk right past.

name: Spruce Starter House
description: Credit: Gorillo

name: Spruce Treehouse
description: A minecraft treehouse built around a tall spruce trunk, with a wraparound deck under the leaves. One open platform holds a furnace, bed and workspace, reached by a ladder up the trunk. Spruce logs, planks and a bit of stone, cheap to gather. A good starter home with a view over your world.

name: Starter Bamboo Hut
description: Credit: Gorillo

name: Starter House
description: A modern starter house in warm wood with a flat roof, glass walls and a small balcony. Two floors, the ground level fitted with chests and a furnace. Mostly planks and glass, quick to gather. Good first base that still looks planned.

name: Starter House 6
description: A starter house with a steep deepslate roof, plaster walls and a fenced porch. One room inside, enough for a bed, chest and crafting table, with a barrel deck out front. Uses common survival blocks, so you can build it in your first days. Fits any grass or coastal spawn.

name: Starter Japanese House
description: A small japanese house with a flared dark roof, white plaster walls and wood trim on a stone base. One starter room, reached by front steps, with lanterns at the door. Common survival blocks throughout, so you can build it on day one. Works alone or as the first house in a Japanese village.

name: Starter Lake House
description: A minecraft house on a lake with a wood dock, log posts and lanterns along the waterline. Open front room with flowers, chests and a fenced side deck over the water. Mostly logs, planks and stone, nothing rare. Works on any lake or river edge in survival.

name: Starter Mountain House
description: A starter house built straight into a stone cliff, with a wood front, a lantern-lit door and a big window. One room inside with a bed and chests, plus a crop patch by the entrance. Common wood and stone, quick to build. Good first shelter at the base of a mountain.

name: Starter Underground House
description: A starter underground base dug straight into the grass, hidden under a wood and glass roof. One sunken room below, lit by daylight through the skylight. Mostly digging plus some planks and glass, one of the cheapest homes you can make. Good for a first night that mobs cannot find.

name: Starter Water House
description: A starter house on stilts over open water, built from spruce logs with a wooden dock out front. One room with a window, a door and flower boxes on the sides. Common wood blocks, so you can build it on day one. Good first base for an ocean or lake spawn.

name: Starter Wooden Modern House
description: A starter house in plain wood with a modern flat roof and a wide window upstairs. Bedroom and seating above, a sheltered entry with door and storage below. All basic wood, glass and a few lanterns, fine for early game. Good first base by a lake or on open grass.

name: Stone House
description: A medieval house with stone steps, white plaster walls, dark roofing and wood framing, plus a covered porch on the side. Two floors under a split roof, with lanterns and planter boxes outside. Uses common survival blocks. Works solo or in a medieval village.

name: Stone and Oak Starter House
description: A starter house with a stone base, oak walls and a cobblestone roof. One main room behind a large window, side stairs up to a railed landing. Built from cobble and oak, all early game blocks. Solid first home for a survival world.

name: Stump House
description: A starter house built into a tree stump, with bark walls, leafy patches on top and a chopped trunk poking out. A wood door leads to one small room inside. Log blocks and leaves, cheap on day one. Drop it in any forest and it blends right in.

name: Survival City
description: A walled survival base with several wood houses, a windmill, crop plots, animal pens and a central pond. You get living space, farms and storage in one compound. It covers a big footprint, so expect plenty of blocks and time. Works as a full village start for a survival world.

name: Survival Duo House
description: A survival house split into two wood cabins with stone brick roofs, joined by a shared stair deck. Two separate rooms, one per player, so a duo can live side by side. Uses common wood and stone, cheap to build early. Good first base for two friends.

name: Survival House
description: A small minecraft house in spruce and oak with double doors and a stepped roof. One open room inside, enough for a bed, chests and a crafting corner. Only wood and torches, so it goes up fast. Handy first shelter or a village extra.

name: Survival Lake House
description: A survival house on the water with a spruce frame, cobblestone roof edges and a fenced deck. Open porch out front with roses and lanterns, plus a small dock. Wood and cobble keep it cheap for early game. Works as a lakeside starter base.

name: Survival Underground House
description: A round underground base for survival, split into four sunken rooms around a cross of walkways, with a wood ramp leading in. Each quarter holds its own space for sleeping, storage and crafting under open skylights. Takes real digging but only common wood and glass. A hidden home for a long survival world.

name: Taiga Starter House
description: Credit: Gorillo

name: Tree House
description: A compact minecraft treehouse with a glass-walled room on top of a thick trunk and a leaf canopy for a roof. One lookout room upstairs, benches and flowers around the base. Built from logs, leaves and glass, all easy to gather. Works as a starter home or a watchtower by your base.

name: Tree Stump House
description: A tree stump house with dark log walls, mossy sides, orange fungi and a red mushroom cap on top. A blue door, stone steps and lanterns mark the entrance. Built from logs, moss and mushroom blocks. Fits a swamp, forest, or any fairy-tale build.

name: Two Story Starter House
description: A two story starter house in oak with a cobblestone roof and a front staircase to the balcony. Living space below, a second room upstairs behind the railing. Oak, cobble and lanterns, nothing rare. Roomy first base that leaves space to grow.

name: Underground Base
description: A compact underground base hidden in the grass, marked only by wood platforms and stone corners at the surface. Stairs lead down to a single room with storage and a furnace. Almost no materials, mostly digging with some planks and stone. A quick first-night shelter that stays out of sight.

name: Underground House
description: An underground base dug straight into the ground, with wooden walls, a staircase entrance and a crop farm on the surface above. Inside there is room for a bed, chests and a crafting corner. Costs mostly wood and digging time. A hidden survival home that leaves the landscape untouched.

name: Underwater Bridge Base
description: A minecraft bridge with a base built inside it: a stone arch across the river with wooden rooms and doors set into the front. Lanterns light the walkway on top, rooms sit at water level below. Mostly stone and logs. Crosses a river while doubling as your home.

name: Underwater Modern House
description: A modern house in white concrete that floats at the water line, half above and half below the surface. Open living space inside with a kitchen counter, seating and potted plants. Concrete takes some gathering. Works as an ocean base or a beach-side showpiece.

name: Winter House
description: A minecraft house for winter with a steep slate roof, wood upper floor and a stone wall around the yard. Two storeys plus a walled terrace with its own stairs and a chimney. Mostly wood and stone bricks, cheap to gather. Suits a snowy mountain or taiga base.

name: Witch Hat Pumpkin House
description: A minecraft house shaped like a pumpkin wearing a witch hat, with orange honeycomb walls and a curled dark roof. One room behind the white-walled entry, lanterns and hay bales around the porch. Fits a Halloween world or a fall village.

name: Witch House
description: A minecraft house under a giant witch hat roof, blackstone brim curling over orange terracotta walls. One room inside with a door and cauldron by the entry. Corrupted farmland spreads out front. Works as a Halloween build or a swamp witch hut.

name: Wooden House
description: A large minecraft house in oak and spruce with a wraparound balcony and a fenced roof terrace. Two open floors with space for storage, beds and workstations. Takes plenty of wood, but nothing beyond logs, planks and lanterns. A base to settle into for the long run.

name: Wooden Winter House
description: A single-storey minecraft house in dark wood with a wraparound porch and three gabled roofs. Beds sit out on the deck and a fenced walkway rings the whole build. Almost all spruce, so one tree farm covers it. A solid main base for a taiga or snowy survival world.

name: Woodland Mansion
description: A minecraft mansion with a red brick roof, stone brick base and a central spire. Two floors behind timber framing, with a side porch and balcony overhangs. A big build that takes plenty of wood, stone and brick. Suits a survival world ready for an upgrade.

name: Automatic Door
description: A piston door made of glass that opens on its own when you walk up to it. Step on the pressure plates and both halves slide apart, then close behind you. Needs pistons, redstone and observers, so gather a little iron first. Fits any base entrance or wall.

name: Block Swapper
description: A small redstone machine that swaps the block in front of you when you flip the lever. A crafting table sits in the wall and trades places with another block on demand. Just a stone box, a lever and basic redstone. Handy for hidden rooms and compact bases.

name: Chunk Loader
description: It will only fully load the chunk where the ender pearl is, which means that it will process random ticks even if you are far away. So, your crops will always keep growing as long as you are in the game. Another cool thing is that in the surrounding 3x3 chunk area, redstone processing still works even though random ticks don't. That means your item sortters, super smelters, and other redstone contraptions will stay fully functional across that 3x3 chunk area.

name: Creepy Light
description: A redstone light strip that runs a row of redstone lamps from a lever through repeaters and torch circuits. Flip the lever and the lamps switch along the line. Cheap parts: redstone dust, repeaters, torches and lamps. Use it for flicker lighting in a haunted or spooky build.

name: Dance Floor
description: A redstone dance floor made of glowing lamps framed in stone bricks, with a lantern post on each corner. The lit floor makes a bright spot for parties or a plaza centerpiece. Small footprint and cheap blocks, so it drops into any base or village square.

name: Elytra Launcher
description: An elytra launcher hidden inside a stepped white mound with lanterns on the corners. Step on and it throws you into the air, high enough to open your elytra and fly. Built from quartz-style blocks over a compact redstone core. Place it at your base as a takeoff point.

name: Eye Scanner Door
description: A scanner door set in a stone wall, with an ender eye in an item frame next to a plain white door. Stand at the eye and the redstone opens the door for you, no button needed. A compact circuit hidden behind the wall. Works as a base entrance with some flair.

name: Fully Automatic Door
description: A redstone door hidden in a stone brick wall that opens on its own as you walk up and closes behind you. No buttons and no levers, the wall just parts for you. Stone bricks hide the wiring completely. Use it as a seamless entrance to a base or vault.

name: Item Elevator
description: An item elevator that moves items straight up a dropper tower, from a chest at the bottom to a chest at the top. Load the lower chest and everything travels up on its own. Built from droppers, redstone and stone. Useful under a storage room or above a mine.

name: Super Smelter
description: The Super Smelter is very easy to build and super efficient. With this smelter you can smelt a full stack of items in just 45 seconds!

name: TNT Crafter
description: A TNT crafter that feeds sand and gunpowder from two labeled droppers into an auto-crafting setup, with finished TNT collected in a chest. Keep the droppers stocked and it produces TNT on its own. Small machine, mostly redstone parts. Handy next to a mining or clearing site.

name: Working Castle Gate
description: A working castle gate in a stone gatehouse with battlements and a wooden portcullis. Flip the redstone and the gate slides open or shut, so your entrance actually locks. Mostly stone bricks and cobblestone. Drop it into a castle wall or use it as a stand-alone keep entrance.

name: Allay Statue
description: An allay minecraft statue built from prismarine bricks, with dark eyes and wings spread wide. A small build that takes a couple stacks of one block. Set it by your storage room or hover it near your base as a landmark.

name: Among Us Statue
description: A minecraft statue of an Among Us crewmate in red with a cyan visor. Two colors of blocks and only a few minutes to build. Works at a server spawn, in a minigame lobby or anywhere you want a quick landmark.

name: Anchor Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a ship anchor, built from stone bricks on a shallow water base. Curved arms, a straight shank and a ring at the top. Stone bricks only, cheap to make. Fits harbors, docks and any ocean-themed town square.

name: Angel Statue
description: A minecraft statue of an angel with spread wings, raising a sword overhead. Built from stone bricks on a rough stone base. All common stone, so cost stays low. Fits graveyards, cathedral courtyards or the center of a town plaza.

name: Animatronic
description: A minecraft statue of a shark built from oxidized copper, with cut copper on the belly and a grate mouth. A quick build, only a few stacks of copper blocks. Set it by an ocean base or aquarium.

name: Arctic Fox Statue
description: A small arctic fox minecraft statue in white blocks, sitting with its tail curled on a snowy base. The whole thing uses one block color, so it is a quick, cheap build. Fits a winter base, a snow biome, or a garden corner.

name: Automatic Frog Fountain
description: A small stone fountain that pours water from an arched spout down tiered steps into a pool. Stone bricks up top, a dark mossy base below. Cheap to build with common blocks. Drop it in a garden, courtyard or village square.

name: Axe Holder Statue
description: A small minecraft statue of a warrior holding a long axe, built from stone, deepslate and barrel blocks. Stands on a stepped stone brick pedestal. Only a handful of common blocks, done in minutes. Put it at a gate, along a path or outside an armory.

name: Axolotl Statue
description: A stone axolotl minecraft statue with wide eyes and spiky gills, built from andesite and deepslate. Small and cheap, made from blocks you mine anyway. Sits well by a pond, in a lush cave base, or as a pet memorial.

name: Baby Chicken Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a baby chick in bright yellow blocks, with black eyes, a wide beak and stubby stone legs. Small footprint and only a few block types, so it goes up fast. Drop it beside your chicken pen or anywhere your base needs something cute.

name: Baby Steve Statue
description: A baby Steve minecraft statue with a big head, cyan shirt and blue legs, built from wool or concrete. A small block count in a few colors, so it is done fast. Works as a spawn marker or a fun landmark outside your base.

name: Bee Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a bee, built big in yellow and black with white wings and a stinger. Roughly life-scale to a player, faithful to the mob model. Cheap wool and concrete build. Place it by a flower field, bee farm or garden.

name: Bunny Statue
description: A minecraft statue of the rabbit mob, white blocks with tall gray ears and a red nose. A few blocks wide and cheap to copy in survival. Sits well in a garden, at spawn or next to your house.

name: Cat Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a white cat sitting upright, with green eyes, pink ears and a raised tail. Wool and quartz-style white blocks shape the fur and whiskers. A small block count makes it a quick build. Place it in a garden, by a house, or as a pet memorial.

name: Caterpie Statue
description: A minecraft statue of Caterpie, the green caterpillar Pokemon, with big white eyes and striped legs. Lime wool and a few wood accents, small and cheap to build. A quick decoration for a garden, forest or Pokemon-themed world.

name: Charizard Statue
description: A Charizard minecraft statue in orange blocks with a white belly and wings built from fences and rails. Stands on four legs with a stepped tail. Mostly orange concrete plus fences, so it comes together fast. Set it near your base as a landmark for Pokemon fans.

name: Chicken Statue
description: A minecraft statue of the chicken mob with a white body, orange beak and red comb. A few blocks tall and quick to copy. Put it by your chicken pen or farm entrance as a landmark.

name: Christmas Penguin
description: A minecraft statue of a penguin wearing a red hat, a scarf and a gold bell, standing on a snow patch. Black and white body with an orange beak and feet. Small footprint and cheap blocks, so it goes up fast. Fits a winter world or a Christmas display.

name: Copper Bug-Bot
description: A minecraft statue of a bug robot built from copper blocks, with three grindstone-and-rod legs per side, a framed eye and a spyglass antenna. A small block count, mostly copper. Set it beside a lab, copper farm or industrial build as a mascot.

name: Cow Statue
description: A small minecraft statue of a cow, built from brown and pink blocks in a chunky big-head style. Stands a few blocks tall with ears, a snout and stubby legs. Cheap common blocks, done in minutes. Put it by your barn, pasture or farm entrance.

name: Crab
description: A small minecraft statue of a crab with an orange body, sandy claws and four fence legs. Just a few blocks of terracotta, wood and fences, done in minutes. Drop it on a beach or riverbank for a bit of life.

name: Creeper Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a creeper, green blocks with the black face and four square feet. A short build, only a handful of blocks tall. Green wool or concrete is all it takes. Works as a spawn marker, a garden guard or a warning sign at your base.

name: Dancing Iron Golem
description: A minecraft statue of an iron golem with a carved pumpkin head, iron block body and arms out mid-dance. A quick build at a few blocks tall, using iron blocks and one pumpkin. Put it by your village or front gate as a small guard piece.

name: Dead Dragon
description: A dead ender dragon minecraft statue lying flat on the ground, built from blackstone with pink wing membranes and a sword planted in its head. Candles line the spine. A ground-level build using mostly blackstone. Fits an End scene or a trophy spot outside your base.

name: Demon Hand
description: A minecraft statue of a skeletal hand clawing out of the ground, quartz bones tipped with pointed claws. Five fingers, each ending in a brown spike. Quartz is the main cost. Set it in a graveyard, a boss arena or any spooky corner of your world.

name: Diamond Pickaxe
description: A minecraft statue of a diamond pickaxe, leaning head-down from a stone pedestal. Diamond blocks form the head, wood the handle, stone bricks the stand. Diamond blocks make it pricey, so it reads as a trophy. Plant it outside a mine or at your base entrance.

name: Diamond Sword Statue
description: A giant minecraft statue of a diamond sword stuck blade-down in a stone base. Diamond blocks for the blade, black outline, wood grip and a teal pommel. Simple shape, easy to copy. Marks a spawn, arena or base entrance.

name: Dinosaur
description: A minecraft statue of a dinosaur skeleton, built from wood on a stone display platform. Chain fencing and lamp posts ring the base like a museum exhibit. The skeleton is small; the platform takes most of the blocks. Works as a park or town-square centerpiece.

name: Doggy Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a dog with a red collar, floppy ears and a raised paw. Built from a few wool and concrete colors, so it is quick and cheap. Small footprint. Put it by your front door or next to a pet graveyard.

name: Dragon Skull
description: A giant minecraft statue of a dragon skull in white blocks, with purple portal-block eyes and a mouth full of stone fangs. Horns curve back in dark cobblestone, with grass and vines for age. Takes a good stack of blocks at this size. Place it as a landmark or a hidden lair entrance.

name: Dragon Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a dragon head rearing from a stone base, with water pouring from its mouth. Dark wings crest the skull and purple eyes glow in the sockets. Stone, deepslate and one water source do the job. Works as a fountain for a castle yard or base entrance.

name: Duck Statue
description: A rubber duck minecraft statue in yellow blocks with an orange beak, sized to float on water. A compact build that takes a few stacks of yellow wool or concrete. Park it on a lake or pond for a landmark you can spot from far off.

name: Eagle Statue
description: A minecraft statue of an eagle with raised wings, built from deepslate and dark stone. Layered slabs and walls shape the feathers, and it stands on its own talons. Takes a fair stack of stone blocks. Place it at a base entrance or on a cliff edge.

name: Elephant Statue
description: A minecraft statue of an elephant with its trunk raised, built from stone and andesite. Tusks, big ears and four thick legs you can walk under. Uses common gray stone, though the body takes a fair pile of it. Suits a savanna base, zoo build or park entrance.

name: Ender Dragon Flex
description: A minecraft statue of a kneeling stone knight gripping a nether brick sword, with a dragon egg resting on its arm. A dragon head sits at its foot. Small build, mostly stone bricks. Place it at an End portal room or as an end-game trophy.

name: Enderman Sitting Statue
description: A minecraft statue of an enderman sitting on the ground with a cake in front of it. Long arms curve around the cake, built from blackstone and obsidian with purple eyes. Dark blocks only, low cost, quick to build. A fun landmark for a spawn area or end-themed base.

name: Enderman Statue
description: A minecraft statue of an enderman holding a grass block, built from black and purple blocks. Simple shapes, a small footprint and only a few block types. Quick to copy. Works as a garden piece or a marker outside an End portal room.

name: Fire Sword
description: A small minecraft statue of a sword stuck point-down in a mound of mossy stone, with fire burning at the blade. Only a few blocks, built in minutes. Drop it on a hilltop, at a spawn point or as a landmark on any survival world.

name: Flamingo
description: A small flamingo minecraft statue in pink blocks, standing on one wood leg with a black-tipped beak. A quick build from a handful of blocks. Put it by a pond, beach or garden as a bright yard ornament.

name: Fountain Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a stone figure pouring water into a square brick basin below. The water flows from the jug into the pool, so it works as a real fountain. Stone bricks, andesite and a few water buckets cover it. Sits well in a courtyard, garden or village square.

name: Griffin Statue
description: A griffin minecraft statue in gray stone, rearing on its hind legs with wings raised over a stone platform. Takes a few stacks of stone bricks and deepslate, nothing rare. Guards a castle courtyard, a gate, or a fountain plaza.

name: Grim Reaper
description: A small grim reaper minecraft statue in black concrete with a white skull face, holding a wooden scythe and a soul lantern. A trailing blackstone cloak spreads along the ground. Only a handful of blocks, built in minutes. Set it in a graveyard or Halloween build.

name: Guard Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a guard built from stone and deepslate, holding a tall banner pole with a sprout on top. Stands on a stepped stone brick base. Quick to build with common blocks. Line a pair along an entrance or castle wall.

name: Headless Zombie
description: A minecraft statue of a headless zombie holding its own green head under one arm, built from terracotta on a small stone base. A quick build from a few common blocks. Stand it in your yard or graveyard as a Halloween prop.

name: Horsea
description: A minecraft statue of Horsea, the seahorse Pokemon, in blue prismarine with a curled tail and framed eyes. Small footprint, only a couple of stacks of blocks. Place it by water, in an aquarium or a Pokemon-themed build.

name: Iron Golem Statue
description: A minecraft statue of an iron golem holding out a poppy, built from light gray and blue blocks with vines on its chest. A small blocky figure, a few blocks tall, cheap to build. Place it at a village entrance or outside your base as a guard.

name: Kneeling Guard
description: A minecraft statue of a knight kneeling on one knee, built from stone bricks with a long wooden staff and a lantern at its side. A few stacks of stone and some logs cover it. Works as a memorial, a castle guard or a shrine centerpiece.

name: Mace Statue
description: A minecraft statue of the mace weapon, built from blackstone and stone with a purple handle on a brick pedestal. The spiked head is angled mid swing. Common stone blocks throughout. Set it at a spawn, arena or trophy hall.

name: Mech Robot
description: A minecraft statue of a mech robot in gray stone with orange armor plates. It stands on two legs with vents on the chest and blade arms at the sides. Mostly stone, iron and copper blocks. Guards a base entrance or a modern city plot.

name: Mini Happy Ghast Statue
description: A mini happy ghast minecraft statue in white blocks, with dark eyes and short blue legs. Built from a handful of common blocks, so it goes up in minutes. Drop it near your base, over a lake, or anywhere that needs a floating mascot.

name: Mini Statue
description: A small minecraft statue of a knight holding a red banner, standing on a stone pedestal. Made from stone, deepslate and wool in a compact footprint. Cheap and quick to place. Fits at a castle gate, a village square or along a path as a marker.

name: Mushroom Statue
description: Credit: patryk286125

name: Nether Villager Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a villager rebuilt in nether blocks, with horns and glowing eyes. Nether bricks, netherrack and red brick make the crossed-arms villager pose. All nether materials, so mine there first. Guards a nether portal or marks a nether-themed base.

name: Netherite Sword Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a netherite sword stuck blade-up in a stone pedestal. The pixel-style blade and crossguard copy the item texture in dark and pink blocks. Small base, modest block count. Plant it at your spawn, arena entrance or trophy room.

name: Panda Statue
description: A sitting panda minecraft statue with a white body and blackstone ears, arms and legs. A compact build from two block colors, cheap to gather. Place it in a bamboo garden, a zoo build, or next to your base as a mascot.

name: Pegasus Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a pegasus rearing on its hind legs, built in white blocks on a stone pedestal. Both wings spread wide, with doors as feather detail. Mostly quartz-style white blocks, so gather plenty. Works as a centerpiece for a plaza, fountain or castle courtyard.

name: Pidgey
description: A small Pidgey minecraft statue, a bird in striped wood blocks with a pink beak, folded wings and a head crest. A quick build from common wood. Perch it near your base or in a park as a Pokemon decoration.

name: Pikachu
description: A minecraft statue of Pikachu in yellow blocks with black-tipped ears and a lightning tail. Small and cheap, mostly yellow wool or concrete. A fast decoration for a garden, spawn area or Pokemon-themed world.

name: Poke-ball
description: A small Poke-ball statue made from white and red blocks with a quartz button on the front. Just a handful of blocks, so it takes minutes to place. Use it as a garden prop or scatter a few around a Pokemon themed world.

name: Psyduck
description: A small Psyduck minecraft statue in orange blocks with a white bill, yellow tail and gold feet. A quick build from a handful of colored blocks. Set it near your base or a pond as a Pokemon landmark.

name: Rider Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a rider on a rearing horse, lance in hand, built entirely from gray stone bricks on a stepped base. A compact monument a few blocks tall, cheap in stone. Place it at a castle gate, town square or along a road.

name: Robot
description: A small minecraft statue of a robot with a stone body, orange thruster shoulders and open frame arms. Its face is drawn on a carved block, with a vent grille on the chest. A few stacks of stone and orange blocks cover it. Stands well outside a lab or futuristic base.

name: Seal Statue
description: A small minecraft statue of a seal in white and sand blocks, with a raised head and flat tail. Only a handful of blocks, built in minutes. Sits well on a beach, an ice biome or beside a pool.

name: Sharpedo
description: A small Sharpedo minecraft statue, a shark in blue prismarine-style blocks with a white belly and jagged fins. A quick build from a couple of block types. Drop it in the ocean or by a beach as a Pokemon landmark.

name: Simple Wolf Statue
description: A small minecraft statue of a sitting wolf, built from stone and andesite. Pointed ears, a square snout and front legs planted like the in-game tame wolf. Cheap stone blocks and a quick build. Set it by your front door or at the entrance to a dog pen.

name: Skeleton TNT Yeeter
description: A minecraft statue of a skeleton lifting a TNT block over its head on wooden poles. Only a few blocks tall, so it fits almost anywhere. TNT, white blocks and sticks are the whole cost. Drop it by your base entrance as a warning sign.

name: Snake Statue
description: A small snake statue coiled on a stone platform, built from warped blocks with a wood spiral through the middle. The head rears up with an open mouth over the looped body. Cheap and fast to place. Works as a garden ornament or a marker outside your base.

name: Spear Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a giant spear with a diamond tip, planted at an angle in a stone base. The wooden shaft leans like it was thrown and stuck. Wood, stone and a few blue blocks cover the cost. Set it at a spawn, arena or base entrance as a landmark.

name: Statue Of Liberty
description: A minecraft statue of the Statue of Liberty, built in weathered copper on a stone pedestal with a gold torch. Crown, raised arm and tablet are all there. It stands tall, so expect to place plenty of copper blocks. A landmark for a city, harbor or server spawn.

name: Steve Statue
description: A big minecraft statue of Steve in his teal shirt and blue pants, built block by block from wool or concrete. Stands many blocks tall, so it takes a fair pile of colored blocks. Set it at your spawn, base entrance or server plaza as a landmark.

name: Stone Pickaxe Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a stone pickaxe, angled head-down on a stone brick pedestal. Stone bricks form the head, wood blocks the handle. Common blocks, so it goes up fast. Set it at a mine entrance or town square as a landmark.

name: TNT Yeeter
description: A minecraft statue of a skeleton flying on a TNT block, arms spread wide along wooden planks. Small footprint, just a few blocks tall. TNT, bone-white blocks and wood are all it takes. A joke piece for your base entrance or spawn area.

name: Techno Blade
description: A big minecraft statue of Technoblade, the pig king, with a gold crown and a red royal coat. Stands several blocks tall and reads clearly from a distance. Mostly wool and concrete, so it takes plenty of colored blocks. A tribute piece for a spawn area or server plot.

name: Trident Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a trident planted tip-up on a stone stand. The head is built from quartz and diorite, the shaft from prismarine and diamond blocks. Small footprint, low block count. Marks an ocean monument base, a beach spawn or an underwater-themed area.

name: Tuff Golem Statue
description: A tuff golem minecraft statue with green eyes and a red cloak, built from tuff and colored blocks. Small footprint and a low block count, so it is a fast build. Stand it in a hall, a museum room, or by your front door.

name: Venusaur
description: A small Venusaur minecraft statue in blue-green blocks with lime leaves and a red flower on its back. A quick build from a few block types. Stands well in a garden or beside other Pokemon statues around your base.

name: Void Enderman Statue
description: A minecraft statue of an enderman face with glowing purple blocks and two black arms reaching out. The head floats free with scattered particle blocks around it. Cheap to build, mostly concrete and purpurs of glowing block. Set it in a dark area so the purple glow stands out.

name: Warden Statue
description: A small warden minecraft statue in sculk blocks with a glowing blue chest, white teeth, crimson wings and dangling roots below. Needs sculk and nether blocks, so a trip to the deep dark helps. Stand it at your base entrance or in a deep dark scene.

name: Warped Snake
description: A minecraft statue of a coiled snake built from warped blocks, with a red tongue sticking out. It stands a few blocks tall on a simple S-curve frame. Warped stems from the Nether cover the whole thing. A quick decoration for a swamp, garden or Nether-themed area.

name: Warrior Mini Statue
description: A small minecraft statue of an armored warrior holding a shield and a lava-tipped staff. Dark stone body on a two-step stone base. Only a chunk of blocks, so it goes up fast. Guards a gate, courtyard or base entrance.

name: Warrior Statue
description: A stone warrior minecraft statue with a raised sword arm, built from stone bricks and cobblestone walls. Only a few stacks of stone blocks, all easy to gather. Guards a castle gate, a village entrance, or the path to your base.

name: Wooden Villager Statue
description: A minecraft statue of a villager head and crossed arms, built from wood planks and logs. The big nose, unibrow and folded sleeves are all there. A small footprint and only common wood, so it goes up fast. Drop it at a village entrance or trading hall.

name: ATR 42 Aircraft
description: An ATR 42 passenger plane in white blocks, with twin propeller engines, long wings and a raised tail. Windows run down the fuselage. Mostly white concrete and gray detail blocks, a fair amount of them. Parks at an airport build or open runway.

name: Beechcraft Bonanza Aircraft
description: A small propeller plane in white and red, modeled on the Beechcraft Bonanza. Low wings, single nose propeller, tail fin and landing gear underneath. A compact build using common blocks. Park it at an airstrip or on the lawn of a modern base.

name: Bombardier CRJ100 Aircraft
description: A Bombardier CRJ100 airliner in white, with swept wings, twin rear engines and a row of cabin windows. A display piece, it does not fly. Mostly white concrete, so gather plenty. Park it at an airport build or on a runway strip.

name: Cessna Caravan Aircraft
description: A single-prop plane in cyan and prismarine with long straight wings and a chain propeller on the nose. High-wing design with wheels below and a tail fin at the back. Uses prismarine bricks and sea lanterns for the frame. Sits well beside a hangar or an airfield build.

name: Cessna Citation Latitude Aircraft
description: A private jet in white and red with swept wings, a T-tail and rear engines, modeled on a Cessna Citation Latitude. Display build only, it does not fly. Mostly white concrete with red terracotta trim. Sits well on an airport runway or a mansion airstrip.

name: Cessna Golden Eagle Aircraft
description: A small twin-engine plane in white and purple with grey engine blocks, spinning chain propellers and low wings. Built at a size you can walk on, with wheels underneath and a raised tail fin. Uses common blocks, so it comes together fast. Park it on a runway or beside an airport build.

name: Cessna Skymaster Aircraft
description: A small propeller plane with twin tail booms, white wings and teal engine blocks, modeled on a Cessna Skymaster. Decoration only, it does not fly. Uses concrete, glazed terracotta and chains for detail. Park it on a runway or an island airstrip.

name: Cherry Blossom Boat
description: A sailing boat in cherry blossom colors, with pink sails, a pale pink hull and a covered stern deck. Chests sit at the bow and lanterns line the railings. Mostly cherry planks and wool. Anchor it off a cherry grove or use it as a harbor piece.

name: Covered Wagon
description: A covered wagon pulled by two horses, with a wood frame, white canvas top and a driver's bench up front. Built from planks, wool and fences, so it costs little. Park it on a trail, by a camp or outside a village for a frontier look.

name: Drone
description: A small drone with four rotor frames made from white stained glass panes around a stone body. A camera lens and lights sit underneath. A handful of blocks, done in minutes. Hang it in the air over a modern base or city build as a prop.

name: Fishing Boat
description: A wooden fishing boat with a covered deck, a stone chimney and a lantern hung at the bow. Barrels and chests on board give it a working look and some storage. Built from planks and fences, all cheap wood. Anchor it off a dock or a coastal village.

name: Formula Car Statue
description: A Formula 1 race car in white blocks with a blue windshield and blackstone tires. Front and rear wings, a raised cockpit, engine detail on top. Small footprint, cheap blocks. Park it by a race track or garage.

name: Honda Jet Aircraft
description: A small jet aircraft in white and orange, with twin engines mounted over the wings and a low nose. Landing gear, tail fin and cockpit are all shaped from a handful of blocks. A quick build using common materials. Sits well beside a runway or modern base.

name: Medieval Sailing Ship
description: A medieval sailing ship with white sails, blue flags and a stepped wooden hull. Rope ladders climb both masts and lanterns hang from the rigging. Mostly wood and wool, so the cost stays low. Park it in a harbor or sail it into a medieval world.

name: Medieval Ship
description: A medieval sailing ship in dark wood with a single white sail and a crow's nest. A raised stern deck and a hull long enough to fit cabins below. Mostly planks, logs and wool, so it costs little. Moor it at a dock or sail it into a harbor build.

name: Merchant Wagon
description: A merchant wagon with an enclosed wooden cabin, a shingled roof, rear storage wheel and two horses hitched up front. Built from planks, logs and fences in mixed wood tones. Cheap and quick. Park it at a market, camp or village trading post.

name: Mini Battle Tank
description: A small tank built from oxidized copper, with blackstone tracks and a long blackstone barrel. Wood crates and a hatch detail the hull. A compact build using copper, blackstone and planks. Park it at a military base or use it as a battle map prop.

name: Mini Bus
description: A city bus built from white concrete, with tinted glass windows, a roof vent and lamp headlights. Life-size scale, a few blocks tall. Mostly white concrete and glass, cheap to make. Park it on a street in a modern city or at a bus stop build.

name: Mini Car
description: A small car built from brown terracotta, with a glass cabin, item frame wheels and button headlights. Compact enough to park anywhere. Uses a couple of stacks of common blocks. Drop it in a driveway, garage or city street scene.

name: Mini Crane Truck
description: A mini crane truck in yellow concrete with a long boom raised over a glass cab and dark tracked base. The boom stacks yellow, sandstone and stone segments high into the air. Small footprint, common blocks. Park it on a construction site or next to a build in progress.

name: Mini F1 Car
description: A mini F1 car with a red brick body, black wool tires and a white front wing. Low and flat like the real thing, with a nose cone and rear engine detail. A quick build with cheap blocks. Line a few up on a race track or drop one in a garage.

name: Mini Helicopter
description: A mini helicopter in yellow concrete with four white rotor blades, a glass cockpit and a tail rotor. Side doors sit open so you can see inside. Compact and cheap to build. Set it on a helipad, a rooftop or next to a base.

name: Mini Jeep
description: A mini jeep with a stone body, green roof and glass windshield. Chunky black wheels, front headlights and a grille finish the off-road look. Small and quick to put together from common blocks. Park it outside a base or along a road in your city.

name: Mini Motorcycle
description: A mini motorcycle made from orange wool, wood and coal block wheels, with a windshield and a red tail light. Life-size, so a player fits right behind the handlebars. Only a handful of blocks. Park it outside your house or line up a few in a garage.

name: Mini Police Car
description: A mini police car in black and white with a red and blue light bar on the roof. Glass windows, a front grille, an antenna and black wheels complete it. A small build using cheap blocks. Park it at a police station or on a city street.

name: Mini Racing Car
description: A mini racing car in warped teal and blackstone with a glass canopy and a flat rear wing. Low body, wide stance and item-frame wheel detail on the sides. Small enough to finish fast. Put it on a race track or in a showroom with other cars.

name: Mini Tractor
description: A mini tractor in lime green with a glass cab, white fenders and big blackstone wheels. The raised cab and chunky rear tires give it a real farm machine shape. A small build from common blocks. Park it beside a field, a barn or a minecraft farm.

name: Mini Train
description: A mini train engine with a blue cab, red front bumper, dark chimney and a face on the boiler. White smoke trails up from the stack. A tiny build that takes very few blocks. Set it on rails at a station or let it sit as a garden piece.

name: Modern Car
description: A blocky modern car in white and black with glass windows and red tail lights. A parked prop, not a working vehicle. A few stacks of concrete, quartz and glass. Park it in a driveway, garage or city street.

name: Piaggio P.180 Avanti Aircraft
description: A twin-turboprop plane in white and orange, modeled on the Piaggio Avanti. Rear propellers on the wings, small front canards and a high tail. A compact build from common blocks. Park it on a runway or beside a modern airport build.

name: Pilatus PC-12 Aircraft
description: A Pilatus PC-12 plane in white and orange with a propeller nose, long wings and a T-tail. A small door on the side and a black engine intake underneath. Built from quartz, concrete and trapdoors at a size that stays cheap. Parks at an airport or airfield build.

name: Pumpkin Wagon
description: A wooden wagon loaded with pumpkins, one carved face grinning off the front. Fence-post handles at the ground so it reads as parked, not rolling. Cheap wood plus a pumpkin patch of cargo. Fits a fall village, a farm yard or a Halloween scene.

name: Simple Wagon
description: A wooden wagon with a plank bed, fenced sides and a hitch for a horse. Room on the back for a barrel or crate as cargo. All common wood blocks, done in minutes. Park it by a barn, a market or along a village road.

name: Small Cart
description: A small wooden cart with barrel sides, a chest lid on top and two fence handles at the back. All wood blocks, built in a couple of minutes. Park it outside a barn, along a village path or next to a market stall as farm decoration.

name: Viking Ship
description: A Viking longship with a dragon head prow, a red and white striped sail and rows of oars along each side. Shields line the hull and a curled tail rises at the stern. Built from wood, wool and fences, nothing hard to get. Anchor it off the coast of a medieval or Viking base.

name: Wagon
description: A covered wagon with a white wool canopy, wood wheels and a driver's seat up front, hitched to two horses on leads. The red seat and fence hitching posts are all simple blocks. Parks outside a stable, on a trail or in a western town.
